create_TemplateSampler: create a TemplateSampler module to sample rotated BEV image kernels using grid sampling and quadrant optimization
run_conv2d_fft_batchwise: run batchwise FFT-based 2D convolution on signal and kernel tensors with same padding and kernel flipping
create_SparseMapSampler: create a SparseMapSampler module to sample rotated 2D point candidates from an image map using bilinear grid sampling
run_argmax_xyr: run argmax on 3D score tensors to extract x, y, and yaw angle coordinates from flattened indices
run_fuse_gps: run GPS fusion to combine log probability volumes with GPS coordinates using gaussian or hard threshold weighting
